A letter for you 💌

Hey you,

I don't know if I can fit everything I feel into one little website, but I wanted to try.

Thank you for being the person I can spend hours with, talk about absolutely nothing with, fight over the dumbest things with and still miss five minutes later. Thank you for the care, the laughs, the patience and all those little moments that make ordinary days special.

We've grown, changed, laughed, fought, made up and collected so many memories together. And my favourite part isn't one particular day — it's having you as my person.

So on Boyfriend Day, I just want you to know: I love our little world. I love our chaos. I love our stupid conversations. And I love having you in my life. ❤️

Happy Boyfriend Day, my Galijuuu. Here's to many more memories, adventures, laughs and yes… probably more quarrels too. 😂

— Your Apii ❤️
